text: Earlier this year, City Council reclassified Greenwood Avenue from Mortimer to O’Connor as a Collector. Residents of that street had been asking for traffic calming but since it had been classified as a Minor Arterial, their request had not been fulfilled. As the speed limit on Local roads and many Collectors in the area under the jurisdiction of Toronto and East York Community Council are set at 30 km/h, it would be consistent and appropriate to do so on Greenwood Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Mortimer Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Greenwood Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Mortimer Avenue.
